paper_record.title: Charge transfer mediated anomalous photoluminescence enhancement in monolayer MoS2 graphene heterostructure via polystyrene assisted wet transfer
paper_record.abstract: Van der Waals MoS2 graphene heterostructures are compelling candidates for high performance electronic and optoelectronic device applications. However, the interlayer charge transfer typically quenches the photoluminescence of monolayer MoS2, limiting the use of these heterostructures in light emitting applications. In this work, we report an anomalous photoluminescence enhancement in n-type monolayer MoS2 by integrating it with monolayer graphene via polystyrene assisted wet transfer process. Photoluminescence spectroscopy reveals a dominant trion to exciton conversion in the heterostructure. Kelvin probe force microscopy shows a 600 meV increase in the work function of MoS2 upon heterostructure formation. This work function shift, together with the higher work function of graphene, signifies electron transfer from MoS2 to graphene. Shifts in the graphene G and 2D Raman modes further corroborate the interlayer charge transfer. Hydroxyl and epoxy functionalization of graphene following heterostructure formation is evidenced by X ray photoelectron spectroscopy. DFT based Bader charge analysis quantifies the role of these functional groups in facilitating interlayer charge transfer. Collectively, our findings establish polystyrene assisted wet transfer as a practical interface engineering strategy for enhancing excitonic emission in MoS2 graphene heterostructures, thereby advancing their potential for scalable optoelectronic devices.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过聚苯乙烯辅助湿法转移制备的二硫化钼/石墨烯异质结，因界面电荷转移实现了异常的光致发光增强。
one_sentence_summary.en: An anomalous photoluminescence enhancement in monolayer MoS2/graphene heterostructures is achieved via polystyrene-assisted wet transfer mediated by interfacial charge transfer.

problem.zh: 单层二硫化钼与石墨烯构筑的异质结中，层间电荷转移通常会淬灭二硫化钼的光致发光，限制了其在发光器件中的应用。
problem.en: Interlayer charge transfer typically quenches the photoluminescence of monolayer MoS2 in MoS2/graphene heterostructures, limiting their optoelectronic applications.

approach.zh: 利用聚苯乙烯辅助湿法转移将CVD生长的n型单层二硫化钼转移至石墨烯上，并通过光谱、显微表征及密度泛函理论计算研究其界面电荷转移机制。
approach.en: Integrating CVD-grown n-type monolayer MoS2 with graphene using a polystyrene-assisted wet transfer method, and analyzing the interface via spectroscopy, KPFM, XPS, and DFT calculations.

main_takeaway.zh: 湿法转移过程中残留钠离子的消除以及界面引入的羟基和环氧基官能团共同促进了电子从二硫化钼向石墨烯的转移，使负三激子转化为中性激子，从而实现了54倍的光致发光增强。
main_takeaway.en: The depletion of residual sodium ions and the introduction of interfacial hydroxyl and epoxy groups during wet transfer drive electron transfer from MoS2 to graphene, converting trions to neutral excitons and resulting in a 54-fold PL enhancement.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究提供了一种无需外加电场或复杂预化学修饰的、与工艺兼容的界面工程策略，用于调控二维异质结的激子发射。
why_it_matters.en: It offers a process-compatible and scalable interface-engineering strategy to modulate excitonic emission in 2D heterostructures without external gating or complex pre-functionalization.

reason.zh: 详细阐明了湿法转移过程中的化学变化（钠流失与氧官能团化）如何协同调控界面电荷转移，解释了异常的发光增强现象。
reason.en: It clarifies how chemical changes during wet transfer (sodium depletion and oxygen functionalization) cooperatively modulate interfacial charge transfer, explaining the anomalous PL enhancement.

reason.zh: 论文聚焦于二维材料异质结的界面物理与光电性质，结合了丰富的实验表征与理论计算，适合在该期刊发表。
reason.en: The paper focuses on the interface physics and optoelectronic properties of 2D heterostructures, combining comprehensive experimental characterization with DFT calculations, which fits the journal's scope.
